PRICE_STALE.title: Fuel Prices Not Configured
PRICE_STALE.message: No fuel prices have been set for this pump yet. Go to Setup → Fuel Prices to configure them.

ZERO_SALE_SHIFT.title: Zero-Sale Shift Detected
ZERO_SALE_SHIFT.message: Shift '{{shiftName}}' (#{{shiftId}}) was open for over 30 minutes but recorded ₹0 in sales. This may indicate a data entry error or missing readings. Please review.

AUTO_CLOSED_SHIFT.title: Shift Force-Closed Without Readings
AUTO_CLOSED_SHIFT.message: Shift #{{shiftId}} was automatically closed because the operator never submitted closing meter readings. End-meter data is missing — a manual reconciliation is required.

CALIBRATION_DUE.title: Nozzle Calibration Overdue
CALIBRATION_DUE.message: Nozzle #{{nozzleNumber}} calibration was due on {{dueDate}}. Please schedule a calibration to remain compliant.

CALIBRATION_DUE_SOON.title: Nozzle Calibration Due Soon
CALIBRATION_DUE_SOON.message: Nozzle #{{nozzleNumber}} calibration is due on {{dueDate}} ({{daysLeft}} day(s) left). Shifts on this nozzle are blocked after that date until a new calibration is logged.

ANCILLARY_LOW_STOCK.title: Low Product Stock
ANCILLARY_LOW_STOCK.message: {{productName}} has only {{unitsLeft}} unit(s) remaining (threshold: {{threshold}}). Restock soon.

PRICE_CHANGE_OPEN_SHIFT.title: Fuel Price Changed With Open Shifts
PRICE_CHANGE_OPEN_SHIFT.message: {{fuelTypeCode}} price updated to ₹{{price}} but {{openShiftCount}} shift(s) are still open. They will settle at the old price. Close all open shifts to avoid balance discrepancies.

SETTLEMENT_REMINDER.title: {{paymentTypeCode}} Settlement Reminder
SETTLEMENT_REMINDER.message: Record today's {{paymentTypeCode}} settlement — ₹{{pendingAmount}} pending. Go to Settlements to log the credit.

SETTLEMENT_OVERDUE.title: {{paymentTypeCode}} settlement overdue
SETTLEMENT_OVERDUE.message: ₹{{amount}} of {{paymentTypeCode}} collections since {{fromDate}} is past T+2 and not in the bank yet. Record the settlement or follow up with the bank.

WET_STOCK_LOSS.title: Fuel Loss Above Limit
WET_STOCK_LOSS.message: {{tankName}} ({{fuelTypeCode}}) lost {{lossLitres}} L in the last {{days}} days — {{lossPercent}}% of {{salesLitres}} L sold, above the {{limitPercent}}% limit. Check for leaks, meter errors or theft.

DELIVERY_SHORTAGE.title: Short Tanker Delivery
DELIVERY_SHORTAGE.message: {{tankName}} ({{fuelTypeCode}}) received {{shortLitres}} L less than invoice {{invoiceReference}} — {{shortPercent}}% short. A claim for ₹{{claimAmount}} has been raised.

CASH_DROP_PENDING.title: Cash Drop to Confirm
CASH_DROP_PENDING.message: {{operatorName}} dropped ₹{{amount}} into the safe from shift #{{shiftId}}. Count it and confirm or reject it.

SAFE_COUNT_VARIANCE.title: Safe Count Differs
SAFE_COUNT_VARIANCE.message: {{countedByName}} counted ₹{{countedAmount}} in the safe against ₹{{expectedAmount}} expected: {{varianceTypeCode}} by ₹{{amount}}.

DAY_CLOSED.title: Day Closed
DAY_CLOSED.message: {{closedByName}} closed {{date}}. Review the summary and approve it.

CREDIT_REMINDERS_DUE.title: Credit Reminders Due
CREDIT_REMINDERS_DUE.message: Overdue credit clients due a reminder today: {{count}}. Open Credit → Collections.

CREDIT_HOLD_PLACED.title: Credit Put on Hold
CREDIT_HOLD_PLACED.message: {{clientName}} is {{daysOverdue}} days overdue, so new credit is on hold until they pay.

CREDIT_PROMISE_MISSED.title: Promise to Pay Missed
CREDIT_PROMISE_MISSED.message: {{clientName}} promised ₹{{amount}} by {{promisedDate}} but paid ₹{{paidAmount}}. Reminders have resumed.

VEHICLE_CREDIT_FLAGGED.title: Credit Vehicle Flagged
VEHICLE_CREDIT_FLAGGED.message: Credit for {{clientName}} was given today to a vehicle outside its rules ({{registration}}). Check the client's Vehicles tab.

LEAKAGE_RADAR_WEEKLY.title: Radar: Worth a Look
LEAKAGE_RADAR_WEEKLY.message: Over the last {{days}} days, {{people}} people, {{nozzles}} nozzles and {{tanks}} tanks scored Watch or High. Open Radar to see why.
